# @btravstack/cache

> 标签: cache, dependency-injection, redis, typescript, unthrown

## 简介

A Cache port for @btravstack/core: an in-memory adapter, a Redis adapter, and a composition that reports every call to Observers

- 官网：https://github.com/btravstack/btravstack#readme
